text:
Roman Kantserov is the bright spot in a dark Blackhawks start, and everyone covering the team has noticed. The Athletic, the Chicago Sun-Times and Yahoo Sports all wrote about him this week, and Mark Lazerus of The Athletic went furthest: "Roman Kantserov is gonna be a star." The rookie from Magnitogorsk has eight goals in 17 games, a seven-game point streak and goals in three straight. "It’s absolutely a different level here," he told Lazerus, adding that the speed confused him in his first games and that he now feels at home in it.

Here's the honest version. He's scoring on 28% of his shots, and his eight goals came from chances worth about 3.7, a finishing rate that rarely lasts even for real snipers. Chicago is also badly outchanced with him on the ice at five on five. What's encouraging is the skating, 97th percentile in top speed, and the track record: 36 goals in 63 KHL games last season. Our projection's middle case is 26 more goals, so even after a cool-down, this looks like a real NHL scorer.
headline: The bright spot in Chicago
